## Dependency Notes

- `SHARED_CONTRACT.md` is the single source of truth for phase ownership, label vocabularies, OpenAI Ads compatibility, and KPI scoring.
- `projects.id` is the root identifier for all workflow rows.
- OpenAI Ads-compatible hierarchy is `projects -> campaigns -> ad_groups -> creative_variants/ads`.
- `extraction_runs.phase` drives both the live phase rail and seeded replay.
- HITL edits write to `human_reviews` and update entity status.
- Spec 06 owns `campaigns` and `ad_groups`, including `context_hints`, budget/bid/geo defaults, and campaign custom instructions.
- Approved ad groups feed creative generation.
- Spec 04 stops at extraction materialization and draft ad-group ideas. Spec 07 owns `creative_text` and `creative_variants`; Spec 08 owns `monitoring_synthesis` and `performance_snapshots`.
- Approved creatives feed fake deploy and `performance_snapshots`.
- Creative export must obey OpenAI Ads chat-card limits: title max 50, body max 100, image PNG/JPG square <=1200x1200. Video remains Motive-owned future-channel headroom.
- `performance_snapshots.quality_score` is 1-100 and uses `period_start`/`period_end`; do not use 0-10 or `snapshot_date` as canonical fields.
- Seeded demo data must exercise the same tables and UI states as live provider output.
- Pioneer remains post-v1 and should consume stored rows only after the OpenAI-first loop works.
